name: duralumin
description: Duralumin is a lightweight yet remarkably strong alloy made by combining Aluminium with Copper. Its excellent strength-to-weight ratio makes it indispensable in advanced engineering and high-performance designs.

allomancy.description: Enhances the next Investiture-related ability {PAWN} uses drastically, but is consumed entirely.

feruchemy.description: Stores Connection - the ties binding a person to the world they live on, to what they have bonded, and to a Shard.

store.description: This pawn is storing Connection in a duralumin metalmind. Their hold on the world thins. The place they live becomes less theirs, bonds slacken, and what they have earned toward a Shard drains into the metal. None of it is destroyed. It waits.

tap.description: This pawn is tapping a duralumin metalmind, drawing stored Connection back into themselves. Roots take hold again, bonds pull tight, and what was earned toward a Shard returns. A person cannot hold more Connection than they were owed.
